name: glassy-frost-x-wire

styleBlock.medium: Retro-futuristic digital composition combining 3D wireframe mesh vector art, translucent glass distortion overlays, and graphic typography aesthetics
styleBlock.lines: Sharp precision vector grid lines, dense 3D polygonal wireframe meshes, and clean geometric framing lines
styleBlock.light: High-contrast edge illumination, luminescent neon line glow, and diffuse light filtering through stippled glass distortion
styleBlock.texture: Tactile pebbled frosted glass texture, subtle digital noise grain, and fine mesh raster grid patterns
styleBlock.contrast: Extreme visual contrast separating pitch-dark background voids from vivid illuminated wireframes and bright white typographic elements
styleBlock.shading: Grid-contour volumetric shading, flat graphic fills, and refraction-based glass diffusion without traditional soft gradients
